title: After 3 Months Lost at Sea, Five Survivors Are Rescued on Remote Island
summary_full: A boat in Micronesia went missing in July. This weekend, five of its passengers landed, unclothed and emaciated, on an island in Kiribati — more than 3,000 miles away.
